texts.text:
<它突然冒出来，杀了默尔索。还堵住出口，让我们逃不了……>
 <It just appeared out of nowhere and killed Meursault. It even blocked off the way out so we couldn't escape...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<百货公司里为什么会有那种东西到处游荡……？>
 <Why would something like that even be wandering around a department store...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……抱歉，我们在说什么？
 ... Sorry, what are we talking about?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<就是刚才遇到的那个东西，它……>
 <You know, that entity we just encountered, it was...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……既不是扭曲，也不是异想体。
 ... was neither a Distortion nor an Abnormality.

可是……我也不敢肯定，究竟该不该称它为……
 And yet... I couldn't say with any confidence whether I should really call it...

哎，别这样。经理老兄，你把大家的好奇心都勾起来了，可不能说到一半就没下文。
 Oh, come on. You can't get us all curious and then just trail off like that, Manager Bud.
texts.speaker:
格里高尔
 Gregor

texts.text:
<我说的是那个背上钉满钉子的怪物。>
 <I'm talking about that monster with all those nails driven into its back.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
在我们来到洗手间之前……我从未见过那样的存在。
 Such a being... had never once entered my sight prior to our arrival at the restroom.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
……但丁，要是没力气了，就再歇会儿嘛。我们已经找到默尔了，所以……
 ...Dante, why don'tcha rest a little longer if you're outta juice? We found Meur already, so...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
罪人们不停忧心地瞥向我钟表上的指针。等他们终于走开，我便直奔默尔索，问他发生了什么。
 The Sinners kept casting worried glances at the hands of my clock. Once they finally moved away, I went straight to Meursault and asked him what was going on.

<刚才到底怎么回事，默尔索？你——>
 <What the hell happened just now, Meursault? Do you—>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……我记得，经理。
 ... I do remember, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
回答您的问题：其他罪人不记得发生过的事，是因为我们被“送回”了。
 To answer your question, the reason the other Sinners have no memory of what occurred is because we were "returned."
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<“送回”……？>
 <"Returned"...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
意思是，西西弗百货被重置到了某个选择尚未作出之前。
 It means that the Grand Magasin was reset to a point before a particular choice was made.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
大多数人似乎无法察觉这种现象。但您和我，似乎是例外。
 This appears to be a phenomenon that most are incapable of perceiving. You and I, however, appear to be exceptions.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<好吧，先不说这个……到底是什么引发了重置……？>
 <Okay, fine, putting that aside... what caused the reset in the first place...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
它大概想让您作出不同的选择。
 It likely wanted you to make a different choice.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……因为您先前作出的选择，并未被锁链束缚。
 ... Because the choice you made before was not bound in chains.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
出发前，我最好先花点时间理清思绪。
 I should probably take a moment to collect my thoughts before we head out.

那个存在为什么会出现……
 Why did that entity appear...

……我们又为什么被送回来了……？
 ... and why were we sent back...?

不是……现在……
 Not... now...

待命运……归于正轨之时……
 When fate... has fallen into alignment...

那双眼睛直盯着鞋子。
 The eyes are fixed upon the shoes.

再也听不到悲伤的哭声。
 The sound of sorrowful weeping is heard no more.

破损得太严重，已经缝不回去了。
 Torn too badly to be stitched back together.

一具黑派的尸体。连生前引以为傲的衣料，也没能让这人逃过此劫。
 The corpse of a Noir. Even the fabric they took such pride in couldn't save them from this fate.

一具黑派的尸体。血渗进黑色西装，染成了深红色。
 The corpse of a Noir. Blood seeps into the black suit, turning it dark crimson.

<呼，看来布布也能跟我们一起进来。>
 <Phew, looks like Pwie's able to come in here with the rest of us.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<……是我的错觉，还是布布好像没那么……闹腾了？>
 <... Is it just me, or do they seem somewhat less... hyper?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
自从进入泉，布布那份孩子气的好奇心似乎淡了，取而代之的是些许不安。
 Pwie's childlike curiosity seems to have been dampened and replaced with mild anxiety ever since entering the Fount.

嗯……大概因为这里人太多了。
 Hmm... Must be because it's too crowded in here.
